title: Pyrolignic
summary: PYROLIGNEOUS, PYROLIGNIC PYROLIGNOUS, adjective [Gr., fire; Latin , wood.] Generated or procured by the distillation of wood; a term applied to the acid obtained by the distillation of wood.
